title: confed rm result
description: The `result` of `confed rm --json`: the pages removed on disk, which `confed push --allow-delete` then deletes on the server. With --dry-run nothing is removed and `removed` lists what would be; with --push they are deleted on the server now; declining the --push prompt returns {"removed": [], "cancelled": true}.

anyOf.description: `--push`: removed on disk, then deleted on the server.
`--push` declined at the prompt: nothing was removed.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the page file.

server_deleted.description: Deleted on the server by this run. Only --push sets it; otherwise false.

push_outcome.description: The push that deleted the pages, shaped as the `result` of `confed push --json` (see push.schema.json).
